Engineering Beyond Client Solutions

Our passion for engineering extends beyond client projects. Kawach.AI is Kreeti Technologies' flagship AI-powered Governance, Risk & Compliance platform, built to help organizations simplify compliance, manage risks, and stay audit-ready through intelligent automation.

It reflects the same engineering expertise, innovation, and commitment to building scalable solutions that we bring to every product and partnership.

Explore Kawach.AI
  • DPDP 2023 native — built for India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act from the ground up, not retrofitted.
  • Multi-framework coverage — ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS mapped into one workspace.
  • Automation-first — evidence collection and audit-readiness handled continuously, not once a year.
  • Built by engineers who ship — the same discipline behind 150+ Kreeti projects, applied to our own product.

Real Impact. Real Results.

Proof, not promises

SAAS · NEGOTIATION PLATFORM

Turning scattered email negotiations into one live dashboard

Promio replaced manual, email-driven negotiation workflows with a centralized platform for enterprise sales and marketing teams. By standardizing offers, automating lead qualification, and connecting manufacturers and retailers on one system, it cut administrative drag and gave teams real-time visibility into deal performance.

40%+Reduction in irrelevant business process flow
100%Negotiation data migrated from email threads to one dashboard
AGTECH · GARDEN PLANNING

Turning ZIP codes and guesswork into personalized garden plans

Smart Gardener replaced trial-and-error gardening with a data-driven planner that factors in climate, soil, space, and household size. From plant selection to layout design to weekly care reminders, it guides growers from planning through harvest on any device.

3 devicesWorks seamlessly across computer, iPad, and smartphone
4 seasonsVisual garden planning across the full growing year
AGRI TRADE · CLOUD PLATFORM

Replacing spreadsheets with a unified trading operations hub

Mandala Trading moved from fragmented, spreadsheet-based workflows to a secure, cloud-based platform connecting sales, purchasing, shipping, and finance across global offices. Automated document generation and role-based access eliminated manual bottlenecks in high-volume, multi-region operations.

50%Increase in operational efficiency
75%Reduction in dead stock through improved inventory planning
